title: NO FE Destroy wrong gl*ss FIXED
script:
local GlassModels = workspace:WaitForChild("Glass")
local BasePartsWarning = false
local TransmitterWarning = false

for _, glassModel in ipairs(GlassModels:GetChildren()) do
    if glassModel:IsA("Model") and glassModel.Name == "Model" then
        local Target = {}

        for _, child in ipairs(glassModel:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("BasePart") then
                table.insert(Target, child)
                if #Target == 2 then
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if #Target == 2 then
            local destroyed = false
            for _, part in ipairs(Target) do
                local TouchTransmitter = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter")
                if TouchTransmitter then
                    part:Destroy() -- fixed
                    destroyed = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if not destroyed and not TransmitterWarning then
                print("\n\n            --- WARN ---")
                warn("No TouchTransmitter found, already deleted, or wrong game")
                print("--- WARN ---")
                TransmitterWarning = true
            end
        else
            if not BasePartsWarning then
                print("\n\n            --- WARN ---")
                warn("Not enough BaseParts found in models")
                print("--- WARN ---")                
                BasePartsWarning = true
            end
        end
    end
end
